recent_posts.title: Changelog #326
recent_posts.summary: rust-analyzer v0.3.2887 (2026-05-04) ships new diagnostics including mismatched-array-pat-len, unused-must-use, trait errors, and several type-checking diagnostics. New features include initial support for gen blocks, renaming of elided lifetimes, a .new postfix completion based on expected type, and an unwrap_block assist. Numerous fixes address type inference alignment with rustc, completion correctness, parser recovery, and assist edge cases. Internal work continues migrating assists to SyntaxEditor and refactoring hir-ty generics data structures.

recent_posts.title: Changelog #325
recent_posts.summary: rust-analyzer version 0.3.2878 (2026-04-27) includes one new feature: renaming a struct field now also renames variables in constructors automatically.

recent_posts.title: Changelog #324
recent_posts.summary: rust-analyzer v0.3.2870 (2026-04-20) ships with 20 bug fixes and numerous internal improvements. Fixes include better completions (demoting impl completions when inherent impl exists, respecting #[deprecated], completing hidden enum variants through public aliases, enabling completions inside strings in VS Code), parser support for unstable type const items and impl/mut restrictions, fixes for extract_function, extract_variable in macro calls, MIR evaluation of sized &T, and several panic fixes in code assists. Internally, multiple assists are migrated to SyntaxEditor/SyntaxFactory, salsa and rustc crates are bumped, and dead code is removed.

recent_posts.title: Changelog #323
recent_posts.summary: rust-analyzer changelog #323 (2026-04-13) covers a range of bug fixes and internal improvements. Fixes include correcting Cargo [env] variable override behavior, loading Markdown files into VFS, improved cfg_attr/cfg handling, spurious import completion fixes in qualified paths, better type mismatch quick-fixes, and stale diagnostics with custom check commands. Internal work focuses on migrating assists to SyntaxEditor/SyntaxFactory, adding a workflow to update generated lints, and dependency bumps for ESLint and TypeScript in the VS Code extension.

recent_posts.title: Changelog #322
recent_posts.summary: rust-analyzer v0.3.2854 (2026-04-06) ships a universal VSIX for platforms without pre-built binaries, several new features including macro expansion in #[doc] attributes, support for #[feature(more_qualified_paths)], type hints at end of line, and folding ranges in chained expressions. The release also includes over 20 bug fixes covering code actions (extract_function, convert_let_else_to_match, convert_to_guarded_return), completions, inlay hints, parser error reporting, and multi-workspace project root handling, plus internal refactoring toward SyntaxFactory usage.

recent_posts.title: Changelog #321
recent_posts.summary: rust-analyzer version 0.3.2845 (2026-03-30) includes fixes for asm! sym operand parsing, panics on trailing | in unmerge_match_arm, spurious flychecks with multiple workspaces, indentation after trait_impl_redundant_assoc_item fixes, and improvements to desugar_try_expr with let-else. Internal improvements include migrating several assists to SyntaxFactory/SyntaxEditor, removing Arc from GenericParams and AstIdMap, and various refactoring tasks.

recent_posts.title: Changelog #319
recent_posts.summary: rust-analyzer v0.3.2828 (2026-03-16) ships several bug fixes: multi-byte UTF-8 identifier handling in NameGenerator, crate removal from EditionedFileId, duplicate associated type shorthand resolution, generic arg inference for TraitRef and its associated types, union type naming convention validation, and a recursive file watcher fix.

recent_posts.title: Changelog #318
recent_posts.summary: rust-analyzer v0.3.2819 (2026-03-09) ships one new feature and eleven fixes. The new feature adds navigation to the `From` impl when using "Go to definition" on the `?` operator. Fixes cover associated type lowering, IDE method resolution with `TypingMode::PostAnalysis`, never coercions in struct update syntax, ABI checks, `cfg_select!` expression support, macro call range handling, formatting in `replace_if_let_with_match`, `destructure_struct_binding` on `self` parameters, postfix `let` completion in match arms, VFS updates on file deletion, and a lockfile-path pre-release check for beta. Internal work includes a new `rust-analyzer parse --json` command, `has_pending` methods in `lsp_server`, `smol_str` API improvements ahead of 1.0, assist migrations to `SyntaxEditor`, and LLM rules definition.

recent_posts.title: Changelog #317
recent_posts.summary: rust-analyzer v0.3.2811 (2026-03-02) ships with eight bug fixes: enabling a diagnostic for adding auto traits via casting on `*dyn Tr`, marking the RHS of compound assignments as `ExprIsRead::Yes`, correcting a wrong condition in `Visibility::min`, adding support for `Span::parent` in proc macro expansion, applying `-Zlockfile-path` on pre-release 1.95 toolchains, preventing panics on invalid LSP notifications, eliminating duplicate enum variants in pattern completion, and fixing scrutinee indentation in `replace_if_let_with_match`.

recent_posts.title: Changelog #316
recent_posts.summary: rust-analyzer v0.3.2803 (2026-02-23) release notes covering bug fixes and improvements. Highlights include better `#[cfg]` handling during import insertion/merging, fixes for parameter qualification in `add_missing_impl_members`, improved reference exclusion in macro calls when `excludeTests` is enabled, cycle handling in `sizedness_constraint_for_ty`, fixes for built-in derive trait predicates with two parameters, postfix `let`/`letm` completion in match arms and block tail expressions, and several assist improvements including `toggle_macro_delimiter`, `replace_is_method_with_if_let_method`, `generate_getter_or_setter` field subset selection, and better reference handling in guard/match conversion assists.

top_posts.title: Changelog #272
top_posts.summary: Changelog #272 introduces new features such as the option to disable inlay type hints for closure parameters. It also addresses various fixes including array types from slice patterns, IDE resolution issues, and SCIP indexing of module names. Internal improvements involve the first contribution to avoid using NEON on big-endian AArch64, cache priming phases, and preventing worker thread panics.

top_posts.title: Changelog #203
top_posts.summary: New features include support for opening local documentation in VS Code, assist to convert 'is_some' and 'is_ok' to 'if let', and the addition of the 'rust-analyzer.rust.analyzerTargetDir' option.

top_posts.title: Changelog #317
top_posts.summary: rust-analyzer v0.3.2811 (2026-03-02) ships with eight bug fixes: enabling a diagnostic for adding auto traits via casting on `*dyn Tr`, marking the RHS of compound assignments as `ExprIsRead::Yes`, correcting a wrong condition in `Visibility::min`, adding support for `Span::parent` in proc macro expansion, applying `-Zlockfile-path` on pre-release 1.95 toolchains, preventing panics on invalid LSP notifications, eliminating duplicate enum variants in pattern completion, and fixing scrutinee indentation in `replace_if_let_with_match`.

top_posts.title: Changelog #289
top_posts.summary: Rust-analyzer version 0.3.2490 introduces several improvements including enhanced tuple-to-struct conversion assists, new diagnostics for private struct fields with automatic quickfixes, better cycle handling in type inference, and stabilized diagnostics for unlinked files. Internal improvements focus on parser recovery, macro handling, and workflow automation fixes.
